_comment: Voice quality gate definition (plans/voice-quality.md stage 7). Read by tools/voice-gate.
Frozen inputs: corpus, receiver, analysis, and every profile field except 'gates' and 'description'.
A change to a frozen input changes inputs_fingerprint; the harness then refuses to compare with the baseline.
Gates may change. 'enforced': false prints a failing gate but does not fail the run.
Times are seconds of sender audio from the run start. Delays and stalls are ms.

profiles.name: clean
profiles.description: LAN-like: 20 ms one way, 1 ms jitter, no loss.

gates.note: no delay build-up on a clean link
no delay build-up on a clean link
stages 2 and 3: mouth-to-ear delay on a 20 ms link

profiles.name: home-wifi
profiles.description: Home Wi-Fi: 15 ms, 6 ms jitter, 2 % random loss, short bursts, 2 stalls of 120 ms per minute, rare reorder.

gates.note: stage 1.1: one concealment per lost frame
stage 1 gate: flat delay at 2 % loss

profiles.name: mobile
profiles.description: Mobile hotspot: 50 ms, 15 ms jitter, 3 % random loss, bursts, 4 stalls of 250 ms per minute, reorder.

gates.note: stage 3: delay goes down as well as up

profiles.name: bad
profiles.description: Bad link: 80 ms, 35 ms jitter, 7 % random loss, long bursts, 6 stalls of 400 ms per minute, reorder.

gates.note: stage 3: delay goes down as well as up

profiles.name: burst
profiles.description: Clean link (20 ms, 2 ms jitter) with one 5 s burst at 20 s: 60 ms jitter, 10 % loss, a 300 ms stall at its start.

gates.note: stage 3 gate: back to the pre-burst delay within 5 s

profiles.name: drift
profiles.description: Clean link (20 ms, 2 ms jitter), sender clock +100 ppm fast, 10 minutes. Push-to-talk sender, so the stream has no pauses that reset the playout buffer. RNNoise off on the sender: it costs 5 ms per frame in this build and would make this profile alone take 3 minutes; the profile measures the receive clock path.

gates.note: stage 3 gate: zero drift over 10 minutes

profiles.name: outage
profiles.description: Clean link (20 ms, 2 ms jitter) with a 5 s outage at 15 s: every packet in it is lost.

gates.note: stage 3: back to the pre-outage delay within 5 s

profiles.name: wrap
profiles.description: Home Wi-Fi jitter (15 ms, 6 ms), no loss. The RTP sequence starts at 65280, so it wraps after 256 packets, at 6.2 s, inside a word.

gates.note: stage 1.2: the wrap must not reset the jitter buffer
stage 1.2: no packet dropped at the wrap
stage 1.2: no dropout at the wrap
